source.name: Honda Power Equipment, What Wattage Generator Do I Need?

disclaimer: Typical estimate, check your appliance label. Figures are Honda's approximate starting and running wattages, not measurements of a specific model.

appliances.name: Refrigerator or freezer (Energy Star)
appliances.note: Honda lists 132–192 W running; this default uses the higher end for sizing.

appliances.name: Microwave oven (1000 W rated)
appliances.note: Honda lists 1500 W starting and running for a 1000 W microwave. 650 W and 800 W models are listed at 1000 W and 1300 W.

appliances.name: Slow cooker
appliances.note: Honda lists 170–270 W; this default uses the higher end for sizing.

appliances.name: Incandescent lights (per 60 W bulb)
appliances.note: Honda says to use the wattage indicated on the bulb (example: 60 W). Enter your bulb wattage and quantity.

appliances.name: Television, flat screen (46")
appliances.note: Honda also lists a 20" flat screen at 120 W and a tube TV at 300 W.

appliances.name: Radio
appliances.note: Honda lists 50–200 W; this default uses the higher end for sizing.

appliances.name: Laptop computer
appliances.note: Honda lists 200–250 W; this default uses the higher end for sizing.

appliances.name: Desktop computer
appliances.note: Honda lists 600–800 W; this default uses the higher end for sizing. A separate LCD monitor is listed at 30 W.

appliances.name: Printer
appliances.note: Honda lists 400–600 W; this default uses the higher end for sizing.

appliances.name: Furnace fan, gas or fuel oil (1/4 hp)
appliances.note: Honda marks this as often requiring 240 V. Many portable generators and power stations cannot run 240 V loads.

appliances.name: Sump pump (1/3 hp)
appliances.note: Honda marks this as often requiring 240 V. Many portable generators and power stations cannot run 240 V loads.

appliances.name: Clothes dryer (electric)
appliances.note: Honda marks this as often requiring 240 V. Most portable generators and power stations cannot run this load.

appliances.name: Electric range (8-inch element)
appliances.note: Honda marks this as often requiring 240 V. Many portable generators and power stations cannot run 240 V loads.

appliances.name: Hot water heater (electric)
appliances.note: Honda marks this as often requiring 240 V. Most portable generators and power stations cannot run this load.
